total_monthly_commits,\n   170\t            \"total_monthly_merges\": total_monthly_merges,\n   171\t            \"new_truck_factor_developer_count\": new_tf_devs,\n   172\t        })\n   173\t    \n   174\t    return metrics\n   175\t\n   176\t@logger.catch(reraise=True)\n   177\tdef main():\n   178\t    # We need 60 projects - use the templates\n   179\t    selected_projects =
